verified: manifest schema version 2 validates one default and three uniquely registered detect checkpoints
General Manufacturing is the coverage-oriented default; Steel Surface and Concrete & Structural Cracks are selectable specialists
all three local checkpoint hashes match immutable source revisions and all three load with task=detect plus exact checkpoint-native classes
all three models execute through DetectionRuntimeManager and DetectionService on domain-scoped remote probes
lazy loading caches successful services by model ID and does not load weights during FastAPI startup or GET /api/models
standard-color preserves BGR channels while steel-enhanced applies grayscale and CLAHE(2.0, 8x8) over the shared letterbox/restore path
quality-v1 uses per-model weights and an explicit neutral default weight of 1.0
POST /api/inspect and POST /api/stream accept optional modelId, share one inference lock, and return the actual model projection
unknown modelId returns 404; a registered missing or invalid checkpoint returns 409 with an installer command
history persists model IDs and remains readable after a historical model leaves the registry by falling back to its persisted ID as display name
GET /api/models exposes domain, description, native classes, default state, preprocessing profile, and verified installed state
frontend loads the registry, selects the installed API default, disables uninstalled entries, shows exact installer commands, and propagates one selection to upload and live requests
changing the selected upload model aborts and sequence-invalidates the active request before clearing preview and result state
changing the selected live model aborts the current frame and clears stale overlay detections
registry installer supports default, --model, and --all with pinned size/SHA checks and atomic replacement
frontend mock mode exposes the same three-model selection contract
existing upload, stream, history, persistence, filtering, deletion, CSV, annotation, severity, and demo-sample behavior remains covered
frontend tests and Vite production build pass after the multi-model change

known_limitations.detail: The broad default uses confidence 0.05 based on observed runtime behavior. Its mixed-domain probe records predictions, including mismatched source labels, and does not claim accuracy superiority.
Runtime evidence is bound to executed source-file hashes; final sourceCommit convenience pointers remain a later cleanup milestone.

All three models have real DetectionRuntimeManager-to-DetectionService evidence, while committed inspect/stream HTTP evidence currently exercises the steel specialist; the three-model HTTP matrix remains part of the final evidence milestone.
Source-balanced demo and model qualification runs record observations without computing or claiming benchmark accuracy; accurate boxes/types/confidence remains PARTIAL.
Python API/detection/storage tests, frontend utilities, validators, and production build exist; full React component and browser end-to-end automation remain planned.
